name: Spear Warrior
source:
"A tired and bored guardsman, quite gifted with a spear." - In-game description

Spear Warrior is a type of monster encountered early on in the dungeon. They take their guard duty quite seriously, with the one captured by the player admitting to having stood guard at a previous post for several years. However, she has a clear desire for battle, accepting [url=/c48304/]Yomi[/url]'s recruitment offer due to severe boredom with her current work.

Floor(s): 5-7
